Frequently asked questions

Can you clean after business hours?

Yes. Most of our office clients prefer evening or early-morning cleaning so the work never interrupts their team.

Do you bring your own supplies and equipment?

Yes. We bring professional equipment and eco-friendly products. If you prefer specific products, we can use yours.

How often should my office be cleaned?

It depends on your traffic. Small offices usually choose 1–3 visits per week; busy offices and clinics often need daily service. We recommend a plan during the free walkthrough.
